As of Nov. 2, 2026, Vistra had executed about $6.7 billion in share repurchases since November 2021 and had roughly 339 million shares outstanding, a reduction of about 30% from the count on Nov. 2, 2021.

As of Sept. 30, 2026, total available liquidity was approximately $8,923 million, including $2,743 million in cash and cash equivalents, $4,714 million available under the corporate revolving credit facility, and $1,466 million available under the commodity-linked revolving credit facility.
